dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I'm a ship craftsman. I'm responsible for ship repairs and maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: When there's no work to do, I'll carry out new research on such questions as how to expand a ship's cabin capacity without compromising the structural integrity of the hull...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But I'm no researcher after all. I don't have a lot of theoretical knowledge, no means to conduct experiments, and I have no friends who study in Kshahrewar...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I've submitted a request to the Akasha Terminal, but it seems to believe that I know enough already...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: With regards to my daily work alone, it is indeed enough. But I really want to make some new breakthroughs...
